text: 2026-07-22 Docker recheck after user restart: desktop-linux remains selected. docker info did not receive a server response after repeated 10-30 s probes. docker desktop status reported unavailable, while docker desktop start reported already running. A native docker desktop restart then failed to stop eight Docker Desktop/backend processes and was interrupted after 45 s; a subsequent docker info still hung. ANTs version/image identity and the fair comparison remain inadmissible until the daemon responds. No benchmark was started.
